lines.text: Ephraim was exalted in Israel, but he incurred guilt through Dagon and died, and the people made idols from their silver.
The LORD says He knew them in the wilderness, but once they were satisfied, their hearts became proud and they forgot Him.
The LORD says He will pounce like a lion, lurk like a leopard, and attack like a wolf robbed of her cubs.
The LORD asks where their king is to save them, and says in His anger He gave them a king and in His wrath took him away.
An east wind from the LORD will dry up Ephraim's spring, and Samaria will bear her guilt because she rebelled against her God.
